versions.short: The bill would require facilities that store lithium-ion batteries before recycling them to follow hazardous waste handling rules for large quantity handlers of universal waste until the EPA issues a new rule on lithium-ion batteries. It would direct the EPA Administrator to issue that rule within 18 months of enactment, considering tailored requirements, support for recycling and recovery of critical minerals, and additional safety measures. It would also update a reference in the Mercury-Containing and Rechargeable Battery Management Act to point to part 273 of title 40 of the Code of Federal Regulations.
